# Lx Manage Data Fields — Cross-Mapping (UI ↔ PostgreSQL ↔ ASG Requirement)

Sources merged into this file:
1. **Lx UI — Manage Data Fields** (Global + Firm) — `data-fields-global-tree-rows.json`, `data-fields-firm-tree-rows.json`.
2. **Lucernex → PostgreSQL inventory (jcrew)** — `Lucernex_to_PostgreSQL_Inventory_jcrew.xlsx`.
3. **ASG Edge Plus Draft Feature List V1.xlsx** — sheets `ExistingGlobalFields`, `NeededGlobalFields`, `ExistingFirmFields`, `NeededFirmFields`.
